description_en: Queries the diagnostic results of the access layer
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-controller-detection --db-cluster-id amv-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeControllerDetection

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language. Valid values:

zh: simplified Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
zh：简体中文（默认语言）。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

DetectionItems.description_en: The queried detection items and detection results
DetectionItems.description_zh: 检测项及检测结果列表

items.description_en: The queried detection item and detection result
items.description_zh: 检测项及检测结果对象

Message.description_en: The information about the detection result
Message.example: A CPU increase is detected on the access node.

Name.description_en: The name of the detection item

Status.description_en:
The severity level of the detection result. Valid values:

NORMAL
WARNING
CRITICAL
Status.description_zh:
检测结果状态。取值：

NORMAL
WARNING
CRITICAL

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 检测结果记录数，由检测项的实际检测结果决定
